description:
FamilyWise HQ is a family organizer and meal planner that helps you manage shared plans in ChatGPT. Plan weekly meals, save recipes and side dishes, manage grocery and shopping lists, and organize your FamilyWise calendar, reminders, chores and routines.

Get help with your next setup step, ask for a weekly family briefing, adjust dinner plans, or assign an everyday routine to a family member. Review the proposed changes and confirm before anything is saved to your authorized Home.

Connect your existing FamilyWise HQ account and shared Home. FamilyWise Plus or Premium is required. The connection does not access health information, medications or private family-member profiles, and it cannot change calendars outside FamilyWise.

defaultPrompt: Help me get started: check my FamilyWise Home and show the next setup step. Don’t change anything yet.
Plan next week’s dinners using our saved meals and family calendar, then help with the grocery list. Preview changes first.
Help me set up an after-school routine for my child. Show the exact routine and ask before saving.
